observed_structure: Each lane first zeroes its value-weighted payload accumulator; the exponential summary starts with a finite-minimum maximum reference and a zero denominator.
An optional sink seeds the maximum reference and denominator only in SIMDgroup zero while the payload remains zero.
Each admitted key produces a SIMD-reduced score after causal, boolean-mask, or float-mask handling.
For each score, the code selects a new maximum, rescales the prior denominator by exp(old_max-new_max), and adds exp(score-new_max).
The value-weighted payload is updated with the same old-summary and new-score factors used by the denominator.
Lane zero publishes each SIMDgroup maximum and denominator before a threadgroup barrier; the partial denominators are then aligned to the merged maximum and summed.
Each payload component is transposed through the outputs array, aligned with the same partial-summary factor, summed, and divided by the merged denominator unless that denominator is zero.
variant_notes: Causal, boolean, and float masks are mutually exclusive branches in the cited score-admission path; the float mask also adds a score bias.
The sink is a denominator-only pseudo-logit seeded once by SIMDgroup zero, not a value contribution repeated by every SIMDgroup.
The zero-denominator branch leaves the carried payload unnormalized instead of dividing by zero.
This observation is limited to the cited sdpa_vector symbol and does not normalize the other two-pass symbols in the same file.
